[Documentation] This now omits `server.port` from the stable telemetry contract even though `ElasticsearchTransportAttributesGetter#getServerPort` still returns the non-default target port and the shared transport tests assert it (`elasticsearch-transport-common-5.0/.../AbstractElasticsearchTransportClientTest.java:123-137`). Please fix the telemetry collection/source coverage so this generated entry retains `server.port`, then regenerate this file rather than editing it directly.

This issue also appears on line 9583 of the same file.
